I have done everything for him, consulted various doctors, etc and Amils. All Amils said he is under influence. Can you please look into his case and advise me. Question: My son, age 25 married is under effects of Jinnat/Jadoo from the last 20 years. I have done everything for him, consulted various doctors, etc and Amils. All Amils said he is under influence. Can you please look into his case and advise me. Answer ID: 157062 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 338/272/N=3/1439) Ask your son to do the following three acts regularly, in-shaAllah, all the effects of jinnat and jadu will end. (1) Ask him to read Manzil daily after Fajr and Maghrib salah daily. (2) Ask him to read Ayatul Kursi, Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq and Surah Nas 3-3 times each after Fajr and Maghrib salah and at the time of going to bed and blow on his hands and pass the hands over his body without a gap. (3) All the three times i.e. at the time of breakfast and dinner and lunch time before eating he should read Surah Falaq and Surah Nas 7-7 times each with durood 11-11 times before and after and blow on the food and eat thereafter. May Allah confer health upon your son and save him against all the magic and demon effects etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
